subject: Game Theory
title: Insurance Menus
description: A short lesson to help you apply Insurance Menus.

hook.text: Insurers offer two plans: low premium with high deductible, or high premium with low deductible. Why not just one?

buildup.text: Different customers have different risk profiles. Offering one plan attracts the wrong mix.

discovery.text: Risky customers choose full coverage. Healthy customers prefer low premiums. The menu separates them.

twist.text: Cross-subsidization disappears: each group pays for its own risk. This is more efficient but less equitable.

climax.text: The trade-off: more screening improves efficiency but can leave high-risk individuals unable to afford coverage.

quiz.question: How do insurance menus screen customers?
options: By offering options that different risk types prefer
